label: Every GOD_4 apprehending through good-general favouring HAS_INTELLECT_1
paraphrase: OPEN recognition bridge, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every g that is GOD_4, has a good-general favouring determination and itself apprehends some content about some candidate satisfies the unary HAS_INTELLECT_1. It reads such apprehension as sufficient for intellect, not as required by it. It also carries the intellectual, as against sensory, grade of HAS_INTELLECT_1: favouring by the betterness of candidates that are not present inputs, with their end content held fixed, is read as grasping goodness as such; nothing in the apprehension relation itself distinguishes the grades.
